title: service-print: print a record on a named print page, so an app need not make its everyday record page the printed document (hotcrm REQ-0008 quote print)
body:
Ruled: 6439306670 · letter A · 2026-10-27T10:21Z

Filing gate **② a decision only the maintainer can make** (a new capability: which page a record prints on). Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat (`huangyiirene`, session `session_01J8VVAnPkgK6CWrJa6t7Fk5`) at the maintainer's request in the HotCRM project thread: she chose 「等平台支持打印指定页」 over shipping the quote print on the default page, then asked 「那是否应该给平台提功能建议决策卡」 (2026-10-27).

## 维护者速读

**One-line problem.** To print a quote today, HotCRM must turn the quote's everyday record page into the printed document. Reps then lose the status path, the highlights, the Details/Related tabs and the activity feed on every quote, every day, for the sake of one button.

**Recommendation: A**, letting `service-print` print a record on a named print page of its object through the console's named record-page route. That route already shipped in 18.2.0 and refuses a wrong name with a visible not-found state. Only the server half is missing.

## Background

- `service-print` (#23811, `b15f8a199`) renders `CONSOLE/apps/APP/OBJECT/record/ID` and refuses any page that is not the object's default record page (`packages/services/service-print/src/print-service.ts`, `refuseUnlessPrintPage`). The reason given at the time was that "no URL renders a named, non-default page for a record". The PR body names the missing surface as "(objectui): a route that renders a named print page for a record".
- That surface has since landed. objectui#12715 added `RECORD_NAMED_PAGE_ROUTE` = `:objectName/record/:recordId/page/:pageName` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx:280`). It is honoured only for a record page of that object, with no fallback, and its comment says "a print of this URL can never put a different document on paper" (`RecordDetailView.tsx` around line 769). It arrived with the `ui/` import `fd4083141`, which is an ancestor of the 18.2.0 version commit `27f38ada4`.
- A print page may hold only the printable block subset (ruling 「8346 B′」, `packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts` "The print page" section). So a default page that prints cannot also be the working view.

**Governing text:** `content/docs/ui/print-pages.mdx` currently says "The server prints a record on the page the console renders it on, which is the object's **default record page** … A print page that is not the default is refused." Option A rewrites that sentence. No ADR found (`grep -rln "8346" docs/adr` finds only an unrelated mention).
**Protocol:** no spec key changes. `print` and `isDefault` keep their meaning. The request body already carries `page`.

## Premise (re-check)

- `git show origin/main:packages/services/service-print/src/print-service.ts | grep -n "is not the default record page"` → one hit (the refusal is still on main).
- `git grep -n RECORD_NAMED_PAGE_ROUTE origin/main -- ui/` → the route exists.
- Measured in hotcrm by the #2312 thread on 18.1.0: converting `crm_quote`'s default record page to a print page removed the title, the highlights strip, the status path, the Details/Related/Attachments tabs and the Discussion/Activity feed from QTE-0004. Edit, the header actions and the attachments panel remained. The print itself works (201 in about 3.9 s, a 2-page PDF archived).

## Options

| | What changes | What the customer sees | Work |
|---|---|---|---|
| **A** | `service-print` accepts any record page of the object that declares `print`, and renders `…/record/ID/page/PAGE` (the record route stays for the default page). The refusal narrows to "not a record page of this object" and "declares no `print`". Docs and tests follow. | A quote, invoice or contract keeps its working page and gains a separate "document" page. An app can ship several documents per object. | `domain:server`, 1 PR, small: one check, one URL and its tests. The console half has landed. No measured precedent of this exact size; #23811 built the whole service (+4074/−68). |
| **B** | Keep the default-page rule. | Every app that prints an object gives up that object's working page, so HotCRM's quote print stays parked. | none |
| **C** | Let the default page print while hiding its non-printable blocks on paper. | One page serves both uses, but the document layout (terms, letterhead) shows on screen and the working blocks shape the paper. | Larger: it reopens ruling 8346 B′'s printable subset. |

**In business terms:** A is "the quote has a print template", like Salesforce Quote Templates, Odoo QWeb reports or Dynamics Word templates, all of which are separate from the record layout. B is "printing costs you the record screen". C is "the screen is the paper".

<!-- os-decision-facets -->
os-decision-facets
- ① 长远合理性：A 缩小特例。打印页和工作页各司其职，与主流 CRM 的「打印模板独立于记录布局」一致，复用已发布的具名记录页路由，不新增契约。
- ② 业务拉动：今天就撞上。hotcrm #2312（REQ-0008 报价打印第一期）已做完并实测，被这条规则挡住，维护者选择等平台；合同打印（第二期）会再撞一次。
- ③ 防 AI 犯错：A 仍是响亮拒绝。页名不属于该对象、或页面没声明 `print` 都回 400；控制台的具名路由对错误页名显示「找不到页面」，不会退回默认页，不会印错文档。
- ④ 不扩散：A 不新增任何键，只放宽一条服务端检查并改一个 URL；B 让每个应用各自牺牲工作页，C 会重开 8346 B′ 的可打印子集。

Prior rulings read: `8346`, `print page`, `default record page`, `named record page` → #22158, #22269, #22270, #23985 (all closed, all the #8346 chain), objectui#12715 landed; ADR none; thread: the HotCRM project thread above.

**Recommendation: A.** Judged on ① alone, A is where printing should end up in two years: documents are pages of their own, as in every mainstream CRM. ②③④ do not flip it. The confidence gap is that A's size is estimated, not measured. Self-check: "on ① alone, A; do ②③④ flip it: no".

**After the ruling:** for A, triage routes it to `domain:server`; one PR changes `refuseUnlessPrintPage`, builds the URL from `req.page` when it is not the default, updates `print-pages.mdx` (en and translations) and adds a dogfood print of a non-default page. hotcrm #2312 unblocks on the npm release that carries it. For B or C, hotcrm #2312 is re-decided by the maintainer in the HotCRM thread.

**The reader who acts:** the objectstack `domain:server` seat (service-print), then the `repo:hotcrm` seat to land #2312.
**Dedupe:** semantic searches on objectstack issues ("print a record on a named print page that is not the default record page"; "service-print print page separate from record page quote document template"; "service-print render named record page route") gave 3, 4 and 7 hits. All are closed, and none asks for this.
